title_zh: 多措并举保供稳价 全力守护群众“菜篮子”——认真落实调研关切，贡布堂综合农贸市场做实民生保供
title_en: Lhasa Takes Multiple Measures to Stabilize Supply and Prices, Safeguarding Residents' "Vegetable Basket"
summary_zh: 拉萨市落实调研关切，多措并举抓好贡布堂综合农贸市场等地的民生商品保供稳价，全力守护群众“菜篮子”。
summary_en: Lhasa has rolled out multiple measures to keep supplies steady and prices stable at the Gongbutang farmers' market and citywide, safeguarding residents' daily food needs.
